_about: Layer 2 (product line) and layer 3 (series) of Cisco UCS, 14 Sep 2026. Lines are Cisco's server families. A part whose SKU names a MODEL (C240, B200, X210c, 6454) sits in that model's series; a part whose SKU names only the FAMILY prefix (UCSC-, UCSB-, UCSX-, UCSXE-, CSP-) sits in '<line> shared parts' (the reviewer's shared-parts rule) — EXCEPT the component kinds: a processor, memory, drive, GPU, network or storage adapter or TPM of the UCS families, generic UCS- or family-prefixed alike, sits in the 'UCS Server Components' line by component type, the platform visible in its SKU prefix (operator, 17 Sep 2026, layering review fix list 4.2: one rule for the components filed two ways; the family shared-parts rules are fenced with the same tokens the component series claim, read from the rows' names). CSP- components stay with the Cloud Services Platform appliance, as MSE- / CMX- parts stay with theirs in wireless. Order is load-bearing: bundles and fabric interconnects first (their SKUs carry server model tokens), model series before family shared parts.
